about: Routes the recipe export does not carry: stations whose recipes are code, not recipe files or export records (the crucible furnace's pot recipes, CrucibleFurnace/Core/PotRecipes.cs), and recipe files of a switch the export is made without (OreProcessing's leaching, #742; 'liquid' is a liquid output's items per litre). Each is one batch: 'slots' are the ingredients (each a list of alternatives [code, items]; 'kept': true for a tool or station part not consumed), 'output' is [code, items], 'byproducts' are [code, expected items] credited at their value, 'kind' a markups.json kind, 'switch' the seraphhorizons config switch that owns it. A route is priced exactly as a recipe of the export (README.md, Rules); a route whose output the export lacks prices nothing. A new station that adds no export record adds its routes here, with its switch; a better home for any of them is an export record (tools/recipe-export), which also shows it in the recipe browser.

routes.about: A full pot, 200 units at the middle of the ratios: 50 % crushed quartz (20), 30 % iron bits (12), 20 % coke (8), melted at yield 0.5 into 100 units, 20 lumps of 5.

A full pot: 50 % chromite (20 legacy crushed chromite or, with OreProcessing, chromite concentrate, 5 units each), 30 % ferrosilicon (12 lumps), 20 % lime (8), at yield 0.5: 20 lumps, and a slag per 25 units charged (8).
A full pot: 80 % iron (1.6 ingots or 32 bits), 20 % ferrochrome (8 lumps), at yield 1: 200 units, poured into 2 ingots.
Leaching (#742; the recipe file is OreProcessing's, absent from an export made with it off): a raw borax and a litre of water, sealed a day, give a litre of crude borax liquor.
Leaching: a raw saltpeter and a litre of water give a litre of crude saltpeter liquor.
Leaching: a raw alum and a litre of water give a litre of crude alum liquor.
Evaporating (#742): a litre of crude borax liquor boils down in the cooking pot to a borax powder. Dearer than the quern's route with the switch off, so it prices nothing but itself.
Evaporating: a litre of crude saltpeter liquor boils down to a saltpeter (a raw: unchanged).
Evaporating: a litre of crude alum liquor boils down to an alum powder.

The still (boiler and condenser, Ore/Processing/MercuryStill.cs) retorts one cinnabar into a tenth of a litre of mercury, nothing left behind (config/ore-processing.json retort.cinnabar). Its export records exist only with OreProcessing on. The still's markup, as spirits.
As crushed cinnabar: a tenth of a litre of mercury from one.

The still retorts one amalgam: its gold stays behind as one retorted sponge (5 units, smelts whole). The mercury it returns (9 portions, 90 % of the amalgam pan's 10) is not credited: the amalgam's own price leaves out the pan's mercury, which goes round between the pan and the still.
As gold amalgam: one silver sponge from one.
